When does New Year 2027 start in the United States?

The United States spans 6 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is New York (UTC-05:00) at 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027, and the last is Honolulu (UTC-10:00), 5 hours later.

The countdown above follows New York, where midnight falls at 05:00 UTC.

The United States in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). New York follows 19 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 6 hours after New York.

When the clock strikes midnight in New York, 180 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-04:00): Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more
  • Just after (UTC-06:00): Canada (Winnipeg), Costa Rica, Ecuador (Galápagos Islands), El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico (Mexico City), Nicaragua and 1 more

Who celebrates at the same time as the United States?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-05:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as New York: Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Mexico (Cancún), Panama, Peru, Bahamas, Haiti and Jamaica.

New Year traditions in the United States

The best-known celebration is the ball drop in Times Square, New York, a tradition that dates back to 1907. In the South, many families eat black-eyed peas on New Year's Day for good luck.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in the United States in UTC?

Midnight in New York corresponds to 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027. Other regions of the United States follow, up to 5 hours apart.

How many time zones does the United States have on New Year's Eve?

The United States uses 6 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC-05:00 in New York to UTC-10:00 in Honolulu.

Is daylight saving time in effect in the United States on New Year's Eve?

No. New York is on standard time (UTC-05:00) on December 31; daylight saving time is only used in summer.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before the United States?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-04:00, which includes Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more.
